reflinkProbe.reason: A repository reflink clone copies ignored/project-local state and needs a second Git ownership/apply/cleanup lifecycle; speed alone cannot replace the registered clean Git worktree boundary.

overlayProbe.reason: Mount-backed isolation would add privileged mount ownership and teardown failure modes without replacing the existing Bubblewrap execution boundary.
